questions.stem: Explain why 3 and 5 can be combined but 3x and 5 cannot.

answer.exemplar: Constants are like terms because they have the same variable part (none), so they add directly; 3x has a variable part and cannot combine with a constant.

questions.explanation: Constants share an empty variable part; 3x does not.
